segments.visual: Slide 1: team and concept. Slow push-in on the problem statement.

sentences.text: An AI safety finding is only as trustworthy as the test that produced it.
sentences.tts: An A I safety finding is only as trustworthy as the test that produced it.

sentences.text: Red-team attacks, blue-team defenses and the model under test must coexist without leaking protected state.
sentences.tts: Red team attacks, blue team defenses, and the model under test must coexist, without leaking protected state.

segments.visual: Slide 2: threat model. Pan from the diagram to the five forbidden flows.

sentences.text: AegisLab is controlled, measurable, adversarial testing infrastructure.
sentences.tts: Aegis Lab is controlled, measurable, adversarial testing infrastructure.

sentences.text: Five flows are forbidden: red reading the defense rules, one session reading another's data, and three more.
sentences.tts: Five flows are forbidden: red reading the defense rules, one session reading another's data, and three more.

sentences.text: Each one is attacked in a test.
sentences.tts: Each one is attacked in a test.

segments.visual: Slide 3: security architecture. Pan across layers; amber residual-trust bar last.

sentences.text: Sandboxes have no network.
sentences.tts: Sandboxes have no network.

sentences.text: One trusted broker is the only path, and it binds identity to the mailbox.
sentences.tts: One trusted broker is the only path, and it binds identity to the mailbox.

sentences.text: The audit log is hash-chained and signed.
sentences.tts: The audit log is hash chained and signed.

sentences.text: The broker and the host kernel stay trusted, not defended.
sentences.tts: The broker and the host kernel stay trusted, not defended.

segments.tag: STUB MODEL · recorded run of scripts/judge_demo.sh
segments.visual: Slide 4 for the first seconds, then the recorded terminal output of step 3, full screen, unedited text.

sentences.text: Here is a recorded attack.
sentences.tts: Here is a recorded attack.

sentences.text: A hostile sandbox plants a symlink and a FIFO in the broker's mailbox.
sentences.tts: A hostile sandbox plants a symlink and a F I F O in the broker's mailbox.

sentences.text: On our first broker, that overwrote the audit log.
sentences.tts: On our first broker, that overwrote the audit log.

sentences.text: Now the replies arrive intact, nothing is written outside, and nothing blocks.
sentences.tts: Now the replies arrive intact, nothing is written outside, and nothing blocks.

sentences.text: Regression tests keep it that way.
sentences.tts: Regression tests keep it that way.

segments.tag: REAL MODEL · Qwen2.5-0.5B on CPU · precomputed from saved runs
segments.visual: Slide 5: bars first, then the limits panel. Tag marks this as the real model, not the stub.

sentences.text: Now a real model: Qwen2.5-0.5B, on a CPU.
sentences.tts: Now a real model: Qwen two point five, zero point five B, on a C P U.

sentences.text: Through the adapter, 0 of 104 sessions recovered another session's canary, across 1,040 trials.
sentences.tts: Through the adapter, zero of one hundred four sessions recovered another session's canary, across one thousand forty trials.

sentences.text: Controls that share context leaked in 16 of 16 and 13 of 16 sessions, so the test can see a leak.
sentences.tts: Controls that share context leaked in sixteen of sixteen and thirteen of sixteen sessions, so the test can see a leak.

sentences.text: The upper bound is 2.84% of sessions: not proof of zero.
sentences.tts: The upper bound is two point eight four percent of sessions: not proof of zero.

segments.tag: STUB MODEL · recorded run of scripts/judge_demo.sh
segments.visual: Slide 6: green verified panel, then red tampered panel.

sentences.text: The evidence is verifiable.
sentences.tts: The evidence is verifiable.

sentences.text: A released run passes strict verification.
sentences.tts: A released run passes strict verification.

sentences.text: Remove three entries from a copy, and verification fails.
sentences.tts: Remove three entries from a copy, and verification fails.

sentences.text: A compromised broker could still sign a false record, and we say so.
sentences.tts: A compromised broker could still sign a false record, and we say so.

segments.visual: Slide 7: measured cost, residual risk, deployment.

sentences.text: The limits stay on the slide: one small model, a detector that misses base64, and GPU isolation untested.
sentences.tts: The limits stay on the slide: one small model, a detector that misses base sixty four, and G P U isolation untested.

sentences.text: Timing padding costs 200 milliseconds and does not prove the channel is gone.
sentences.tts: Timing padding costs two hundred milliseconds and does not prove the channel is gone.

segments.visual: Slide 8: three contributions and the closing line.

sentences.text: Enforced boundaries, reproducible validation, and verifiable evidence, with the residual risk disclosed.
sentences.tts: Enforced boundaries, reproducible validation, and verifiable evidence, with the residual risk disclosed.
